evidence: Issue comments state the maintainer reproduced the anchor-panel crash on some rooms and traced it to invalid API-provided jumpUrl values breaking page rendering.

Target src/BiliLite.UWP/Modules/Detail/LiveRoomVM.cs:852-863 loads the anchor profile; its LiveAnchorProfileGloryInfo model exposes raw jump_url as a string at :1753-1761 and the profile holds the list at :1776-1807.
Target src/BiliLite.UWP/Pages/LiveDetailPage.xaml:833-840 binds each raw jump_url directly to HyperlinkButton.NavigateUri without validation or fallback.

Pinned sibling Models/Common/Live/LiveAnchorProfileGloryInfo.cs:22-30 validates JumpUrl with IsUrl and substitutes ApiHelper.NOT_FOUND_URL for invalid values; Pages/LiveDetailPage.xaml:2091-2103 binds that sanitized property.
dispositions.reason: The maintainer's reported invalid input reaches a URI-typed XAML binding unvalidated in target; the pinned sibling adds an input guard and safe fallback on the same data path.
